audit_limit: Static source inspection only; no structural analyses, tests or source edits. Current comments are evidence of intent, not independent engineering verification.

release_status.profile_status: Both existing named profiles are diagnostic/research, not production acceptance.
release_status.recommended_day1_decision: Freeze the intended production scope and gate evidence; do not set the release flag or relabel PROBE assertions. Build a separately named reviewed production profile only after calibration/applicability evidence closes.

scope_matrix.implemented: Regular rectangular grids, 3-7 bays each direction, 4-9 floors, bay widths 18-30 ft independently, one story height per building 12-18 ft, half-foot increments, height/minimum plan width <=2.25. SDC C/D presets, Site Class C, Risk III, R=8, Cd=5.5, Ie=1.25.
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: Manifest must pin exact sampled population, seed, hazard and motion scaling; distinguish design-force reduction by R from physical input motion scaling. No unscheduled expansion to irregular/tall/shear-wall/dual-system geometries.

scope_matrix.implemented: Perimeter -> perimeter plus core ring -> perimeter plus full core lines. Current column cap is 36 in in every layout. Default system policy has three-story bands and both width and depth nonincreasing upward; invalid state imports/installs are refused. Core means additional moment frames, not shear walls.
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: All selected assignments, caps, vertical dimensions, memberships, clearances, transitions and slab convergence independently checked on final states; failed or partial search is not physical infeasibility.

scope_matrix.implemented: Longitudinal ASTM A706 Grade60 below 16-ft story height; Grade80 at >=16 ft. Failed Grade60 searches can retry Grade80 only with terminal strength/congestion evidence. Hoops and slab mats remain Grade60. Column concrete 6/7/8/9/10 ksi, beams/slab 5/6/8 ksi. One column and one beam concrete grade for the whole frame, not independent grades per band.
scope_matrix.status: Design policies implemented; nonlinear experimental applicability not established by specifying nominal grades.
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: Separate calibration/applicability rows for Grade60/80, fc, confinement, reinforcement and slenderness. Grade60 Beam103 does not validate Grade80 or other concrete ranges.

scope_matrix.implemented: Elastic spines plus IMKPeakOriented end hinges; T/L stiffness and directional composite strength include developed slab bars. Capping regression uses tension-side stem bar ratio max(top,bottom)*bar_area/(b*d); both directions use the same Haselton theta_p absent explicitly separate backbone inputs.
scope_matrix.status: Directional strength exists; directional capping and cyclic calibration remain provisional. Slab-aware reinforcement-ratio and bar-depth treatment need reconciliation with the NIST beam adjustment before release.
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: Positive and negative moment-rotation, yield, cap, postcap, residual, failure definitions; documented conversion from test chord/curvature/slip coordinates to numerical spring. Measured local curves or defensible parameter applicability; separate Grade60/80 and interior T/edge L or explicit justified transfer. Do not install the provisional Beam103 0.030-rad trial as a measured capacity.

scope_matrix.implemented: IMK hinges at both ends, gravity-axial-dependent nominal strengths fixed at build time; two independent bending directions. No changing-axial coupled P-M-M response during NTHA.
scope_matrix.status: Deliberate simplification requiring applicability review; gravity-axial estimates are not dynamic histories.
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: Validate fixed-axial approximation over proposed domain using diagnostic axial variation and biaxial demand; define out-of-domain rejection or implement supported alternative. Validate Grade80 and confinement ranges separately; report clamps.

scope_matrix.topic: Spring stiffness, yield and global elasticity
scope_matrix.implemented: Ke=n*6EI/L, n=20 repository default; spine inertia factor (n+1)/n, cracked modifiers 0.35 beams /0.70 columns. Spring yield My/Ke is not whole-member or whole-building yield. Nominal 0.005 beam/0.004 column angles remain assumptions in the energy regression.
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: Pin n, EI and rotation definitions; verify assembled elastic flexibility and global/modal response independently, not by fitting only local spring yield. n=10 SSD test is a controlled alternative unless adopted with stiffness and invariance evidence.

scope_matrix.implemented: Default legacy_unmapped energy; alternative research profile anchors mode energies to smaller physical yield moment. Haselton column regression extends to beams, uses nominal member yield angles; S/C active and A/K suppressed at 1e12. Corrected explicit-reference adapter requires experimentally_supported profiles with source/specimen IDs, deformation scope, applicability, review provenance and positive per-mode energies.
scope_matrix.status: Release blocker; adapter provenance validation is not experimental truth.
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: Mode-by-mode derivation plus held-out cyclic histories, orientation/sign invariance, hysteretic work agreement, unloading/reloading/deterioration validation. A/K suppression needs explicit reviewed scope, not a guessed fitted value.

scope_matrix.implemented: Grouped models require rigid centerline joints; no finite joint offsets, nonlinear joint panel springs or face slip interfaces. Member hinges retain Haselton bar-slip share. Joint design checks still active. Member elastic spines + flexural hinges do not model nonlinear member shear failure.
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: State exclusions explicitly and define modeled-domain ceiling. Joint/shear checks must be evidence-backed; demonstrate omitted mechanisms do not govern intended response range, or classify those histories as out-of-scope. Cannot claim physically calibrated joint failure/collapse.

scope_matrix.implemented: Fixed base, rigid diaphragm, no soil-foundation flexibility; PDelta columns, Linear beam transformations. Design lateral model can release gravity beams while NTHA all actual frames participate. Biaxial uniform horizontal excitation; 5% mass+initial-stiffness Rayleigh at modes1/3 default; Newmark(0.5,0.25).
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: Gravity/mass ledger, equilibrium and modal checks; explicit damping and timestep sensitivity for representative cases; no hidden fallback periods for production; retain constraints, motions, scaling and solver recovery metadata.

scope_matrix.implemented: hybrid_gnn_lstm_v3 exporter; displacement/drift, force and hinge histories, moment-rotation metadata; diagnostic validation checks full duration, finite shapes, monotonic times/commit counts, installed design/topology and full-rate recorder agreement. Training loader uses response_time_history first2 columns as response target; record-pair isolated splits and train-only normalization.
scope_matrix.required_acceptance: Versioned V6 member-specific feature/schema contract, exact units/signs/timestamps/entity ordering, failed/truncated/out-of-domain quarantine, end-to-end new-sample load and forward/backward smoke. Existing code damage and collapse flags are screening proxies, not calibrated physical failure labels.

proposed_gates_without_invented_numeric_: Evidence-backed, reviewed deformation definitions and calibration applicability for all included member/material families.
All required design checks pass with no unevaluated production items and no PROBE substitutions; provenance is complete.
Full-duration NTHA successful with exact source/profile/design/motion identities; numerical and timestep/damping sensitivity thresholds must be declared before pilot evaluation.
Experimental fit and holdout error tolerances to be agreed before fitting and recorded as research acceptance policy, not code requirements.
No physically unsupported capacity, fixed-axial approximation or omitted mechanism silently accepted; bound response domain or close the evidence gap.
Data schema passes real loader/forward-backward checks and split policy prevents motion-pair leakage.

notable_stale_metadata.issue: Uniform qualification SCOPE still says every gridline in X/Y and shared families; should not be copied verbatim as the current grouped perimeter/core production scope.
Old header says joint shear and slip, but active JOINT_DEFORMATION_SCOPE is joint_shear_only and grouped profiles install neither joint nor slip springs.
Generic STORIES_PER_BAND=2 remains for old policy; selected system_three_story policy explicitly returns3. Audit policy ID, not one constant.

proposed_acceptance_review.overall: These may be adopted as predeclared project targets, not literature-derived universal or code requirements. Their reasonableness does not establish actual model qualification.

experimental.strength_error: My and Mpeak absolute relative error <=10% on each observed direction: sensible provisional target only after matched yield and peak extraction definitions, loading-history alignment and material/geometry provenance.
experimental.rotation_error: Yield/cap error <=20% per observed direction: require consistent deformation coordinate, cap definition and independently observed cap; a test ending while hardening or a shallow numerical peak cannot pass by censored endpoint fitting.
experimental.stiffness_error: Secant/unloading <=20%: define secant displacement levels and unloading windows before fitting. Exclude fixture compliance only with recorded correction; label slip and joint contributions.
experimental.energy_error: Per-loop and cumulative <=20%: define cycle segmentation and work convention, include reversals, baseline corrections and initial/final elastic storage treatment. Relative error not meaningful near zero; predeclare a measurement-informed measurable-energy floor/absolute criterion. Do not let cumulative agreement hide one bad cycle.
experimental.history_error: Force-history NRMSE<=0.20: explicitly define normalization (e.g. maximum absolute measured force for the matched protocol), sample alignment and weighting. Report errors on original loading sequence; do not independently shift or rescale cycles to pass.
experimental.holdout: Independent means specimens/protocols not used to fit parameters, beyond merely different rows of same loop. Report each applicable family and worst direction; pooled averages cannot mask failed families.
experimental.applicability: Passing these targets on Grade60 rectangular beams does not validate Grade80, T/L composite sections or dynamic axial/biaxial columns. Either justify transfer with applicability evidence or exclude unsupported domains.

numerical.dt_halving: <=5% peak drift, acceleration and base-shear change may be declared a project convergence target. Compare the same complete record, source/model/design/damping and physical outputs; original and half-step exports must have matching units and response definitions. Peak acceleration needs full-rate extraction; recorder decimation is not timestep convergence.
numerical.residual_drift: Absolute difference <=0.001 rad/ratio (0.1% story drift) should not alone accept a poor residual prediction near zero. Define a common post-motion settling window and residual statistic, plus a relative criterion where residual magnitude is reliably above a predeclared floor. Current request's 'relative where meaningful' remains underspecified until that floor/criterion is fixed.
numerical.preserve_existing: Do not replace tight export/identity/equilibrium checks with 5% physics targets; they serve different purposes. Neither satisfying solver NormDispIncr nor fitting a local hinge proves timestep convergence/global validation.
